tasks.title: Capture exact baseline
tasks.delta: Record clean status, HEAD, Node/npm versions, installed Pi extension revision, resolved role routes, test commands and baseline failures. Observation only; never modify installed configuration.
tasks.verify: git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD; npm run typecheck
tasks.evidence: Report containing SHA, timestamps, outcomes, unknowns, no source edits

tasks.title: Define static microtask manifest schema
tasks.delta: Define fields taskId, baseSha, repoId, objective, allowPaths, denyPaths, commands, limits, parentHandoffHash, expectedOutputs, mode. Validate defaults and unknown fields; no runtime integration.
tasks.evidence: Valid and invalid JSON fixtures accepted/rejected deterministically

tasks.title: Implement path allowlist matcher
tasks.delta: Pure normalized repository-relative path matcher with explicit deny precedence; reject symlinks, traversal and ambiguous paths; do not grant implicit **.
tasks.evidence: Allow, deny, traversal and symlink cases proved by tests

tasks.title: Implement diff-scope and size validator
tasks.delta: Validate changed paths, total added/deleted lines, generated files and binary changes against static task manifest using git porcelain/diff metadata; read-only only.
tasks.evidence: Reports unexpected paths and oversized changes without mutating tree

tasks.title: Create single-task bootstrap CLI wrapper
tasks.delta: Implement CLI skeleton: load one manifest, verify clean baseline/commit, validate dependencies/handoff, print deterministic execution plan; STOP before invoking a model at this stage. No scheduler imports.
tasks.evidence: One manifest accepted; malformed/handoff mismatch rejected; no model calls

tasks.title: Add result gate and immutable handoff writer
tasks.delta: Verify exit codes + diff policy + commit parent SHA; emit next-task handoff JSON to output directory via atomic write. Block if proof absent. No automatic commits.
tasks.evidence: Tampered/missing test evidence rejected; handoff includes checksum

tasks.title: Inventory all existing error sources
tasks.delta: Document actual event paths from SessionEventStore, APS, IncidentController, retry trace, worker result, stderr and process exits; classify what is already emitted and missing. No implementation.
tasks.evidence: Source map cites exact files and distinct owner for every event

tasks.title: Define normalized error event types
tasks.delta: Add versioned ErrorOccurrence schema with host/session/run/task/model/quantization/runtime, correlation IDs, timestamps, layer, code, severity, redacted summary and artifact refs. Keep incidents/types.ts backward compatible.
tasks.evidence: Schema rejects missing session or unsafe strings

tasks.title: Build deterministic error normalization
tasks.delta: Map known HTTP, network, tool, context, worker result and crash shapes into E02 schema; unknown category is allowed; preserve original evidence reference.
tasks.evidence: Fixture table covers 429,404,400,5xx, timeout, exit status, missing worker result

tasks.title: Add sanitization before durable error capture
tasks.delta: Reuse src/platform/redact.ts; limit payload size and redact tokens, host secrets, env values and paths where appropriate; never store raw prompts in error index.
tasks.evidence: Secret fixtures never appear in persisted representation

tasks.title: Record normalized error occurrences per session
tasks.delta: Adapter emitting E02 records to the EXISTING per-session event writer. Separate event occurrences from deduplicated incidents; no new database.
tasks.evidence: Two concurrent sessions remain isolated; append survives reopen

tasks.title: Capture worker/tool failures at single stable seam
tasks.delta: Wire E05 on one verified SDK failure path only; record model/role/session identity and tool exception; do not change retry or failure behavior. Audit actual hook before editing.
tasks.evidence: Injected worker failure emits one error and preserves existing outcome

tasks.title: Capture gateway and inference failures
tasks.delta: Extend existing retry telemetry with correlatable occurrence identity and safe normalized error reference; preserve single-owner retry semantics and existing APIs.
tasks.evidence: One upstream failure with three layer observations remains one occurrence

tasks.title: Read-only merged host error reader
tasks.delta: Build index by reading existing SessionEventStore events across one verified local namespace; do not assume arbitrary session directories or introduce external service.
tasks.evidence: Time/host/session filters do not open writers or corrupt records

tasks.title: Stable cross-session error fingerprint
tasks.delta: Normalize volatile ids, timestamps, addresses and worktree prefixes while retaining root-cause discriminators; must not collapse 404 vs 429.
tasks.evidence: Equivalent errors correlate; distinct causes remain separate

tasks.title: Aggregate occurrences into issue clusters
tasks.delta: Pure grouping with first/last seen, count, sessions, hosts, affected model/config and recovered/unresolved counts. Keep source event IDs.
tasks.evidence: Stable ordering and correct counts with duplicate retry traces

tasks.title: Classify recovery outcome accurately
tasks.delta: Compute recovered, unresolved, suppressed, and unknown from durable evidence; never infer success from HTTP 200 alone.
tasks.evidence: False recovery claims rejected with missing completion evidence

tasks.title: Read-only diagnose-errors CLI
tasks.delta: Expose --last, --all-sessions, --session, --model, --json, --export. Default local-host read-only; validate args. Do not call an LLM or edit configuration.
tasks.evidence: Fixture index prints exact clustered totals and exit codes

tasks.title: Register /diagnose-errors Pi command
tasks.delta: Discover existing command registration convention; add thin adapter to D05 local read-only diagnostics. No new slash-command registry.
tasks.evidence: Command registration and permission scope tested

tasks.title: Produce bounded diagnostic evidence bundle
tasks.delta: Collect representative sanitized occurrences, linked retries, affected versions and task/handoff IDs; enforce size and privacy limits.
tasks.evidence: Bundle retains reproducible context and redacts all secrets

tasks.title: Add bounded local-model diagnostic adapter
tasks.delta: Build a pure contract/prompt package for Qwen Flash or 27B with evidence and read-only constraints; no automatic dispatch, no source changes, no self-repair.
tasks.evidence: Output requires hypothesis, supporting events, disconfirming evidence and uncertainty

tasks.title: Persist canonical original task identity
tasks.delta: Canonicalize and SHA-256 hash original user goal, scope, explicit non-goals and tests separately from generated planner contracts. Source cannot be overwritten by a model.
tasks.evidence: Modified planner output cannot change authority hash

tasks.title: Fail closed on dropped deny patterns
tasks.delta: For authorization-origin deny constraints, reject contradictions rather than discard; preserve existing parser behavior for planner-origin notes only where safe and explicitly reviewed.
tasks.evidence: Regression: broad grant + restricted subtree does not weaken deny

tasks.title: Constrain malformed-plan fallback
tasks.delta: On planner failure, carry original scope/budget/acceptance to single-task fallback or block when no safe envelope exists; emit visible fallback reason.
tasks.evidence: Malformed planner output cannot expand allowed write paths

tasks.title: Improve goal keyword extraction
tasks.delta: Filter stopwords, weight identifiers/path tokens and later distinctive terms; retain deterministic ordering; avoid expanding context budget.
tasks.evidence: Bluetooth/settings example ranks relevant files ahead of generic text

tasks.title: Surface required context omissions
tasks.delta: Return explicit unavailable/truncated required-context diagnostics; fail worker launch when indispensable evidence is missing unless policy explicitly allows blocked investigation.
tasks.evidence: Missing required file cannot be silently treated as complete context

tasks.title: Attach task authority to APS actions
tasks.delta: Add optional task contract/hash + model quantization provenance fields to APS events; maintain backward compatibility with existing event consumers.
tasks.evidence: Trace links every classified action to known original task or marks unknown

tasks.title: Detect deterministic goal deviation signals
tasks.delta: Flag out-of-scope writes, unrelated new dependencies, unexpected task expansion, and acceptance criterion stagnation. Report evidence not invented numeric certainty.
tasks.evidence: Fixture flags irrelevant refactor; allows legitimate read-only investigation

tasks.title: Carry authority through context handoff
tasks.delta: Preserve original contract hash and constraints through handoff while keeping transcript bounded; reject altered authority on resumed worker. Verify actual handoff schema first.
tasks.evidence: Handoff with edited goal rejected; same goal with new summary accepted

tasks.title: Add scope-integrity result gate
tasks.delta: Before integration verify changed paths against protected task authority; report blocked with exact diff refs. Do not attempt new sandbox or shell pre-hook here.
tasks.evidence: Unauthorized diff never passes to integration; evidence remains recoverable

tasks.title: Catalog current retry ownership by failure
tasks.delta: Document actual owners for 429,404,400,5xx, network timeout, missing worker_result and tool errors; cite files and current retry limits. No changes.
tasks.evidence: One owner proposed for each class; unresolved conflicts explicitly listed

tasks.title: Expose retry correlation ID across layers
tasks.delta: Add stable failure correlation ID so duplicate layer actions are detected without treating independent failures as one; keep existing trace format compatible.
tasks.evidence: Same failure across layers correlated; independent requests separate

tasks.title: Implement retry budget evaluator pure function
tasks.delta: Evaluate max attempts, elapsed time, backoff bounds and exhaustion per incident; zero automatic retries in bootstrap mode.
tasks.evidence: Exhausted budget stops, zero budget never retries

tasks.title: Add endpoint circuit-breaker state machine
tasks.delta: Pure closed/open/half-open decisions for repeated model_not_found, upstream failures, unhealthy response; bounded memory and cooldown; no network calls.
tasks.evidence: Repeated 404 opens circuit, cooldown enables one probe

tasks.title: Define idempotency classifier for recovery
tasks.delta: Mark tool actions safe, unsafe or unknown for replay, default unknown to no replay; explicit safeguards for writes and external calls.
tasks.evidence: Non-idempotent and unknown operations cannot be replayed automatically

tasks.title: Add read-only recovery recommendation engine
tasks.delta: Map normalized errors to retry/hold/failover/stop/review recommendations using R01-R05; do not execute actions in this task.
tasks.evidence: 404 does not endlessly retry; 429 honors server wait; unknown stops

tasks.title: Enable one safe recovery behind opt-in
tasks.delta: Integrate only one demonstrated idempotent retry class with feature flag default-off, existing retry owner, hard attempt cap; no other fallback changes.
tasks.evidence: Flag off unchanged, on bounded and logged, duplicate owner prevented

tasks.title: Record final resolution and regression evidence
tasks.delta: Require failing reproduction, patch/setting identity, passing test, scope validation and observed post-fix status; distinguish temporary recovered vs root cause resolved.
tasks.evidence: Retries alone cannot mark root cause resolved

tasks.title: Inventory existing Herdr telemetry surfaces
tasks.delta: Identify actual mission timeline endpoints, web components, naming conventions, existing error and APS signals; no UI code.
tasks.evidence: Precise integration map with evidence of reusable components

tasks.title: Define normalized diagnostics view model
tasks.delta: Pure model shape for host/session/incident/event/timeline/drift decisions; no API or rendering changes.
tasks.evidence: Input validation and stable filtering tested

tasks.title: Add read-only host diagnostics transport adapter
tasks.delta: Adapt existing Herdr API/event feed to H02; gracefully show unavailable data; do not create new backend or cross-host protocol without evidence.
tasks.evidence: Unavailable host and partial results handled safely

tasks.title: Render error issue list
tasks.delta: Reuse existing Herdr visual tokens/components; show fingerprint, severity, occurrences, sessions, last seen and recovery state; read-only.
tasks.evidence: Escaped HTML and stable sorted incident cards

tasks.title: Render per-session error timeline
tasks.delta: Add chronological timeline by event IDs and step; show link to retry trace and input errors; no control actions.
tasks.evidence: Order, grouping and evidence links tested

tasks.title: Render task drift comparison
tasks.delta: Show original objective vs observed actions, first violation, scope diffs, model/quantization and uncertainty. No fabricated alignment score.
tasks.evidence: Relevant vs unrelated actions visually distinguished using fixtures

tasks.title: Integrate diagnostics route into existing UI
tasks.delta: Add a discoverable navigation link using existing router pattern after confirming exact mount file; do not rewrite dashboard shell.
tasks.evidence: Route works, no navigation regressions; screenshot after integration if available

tasks.title: Create benchmark task fixtures
tasks.delta: Add five tiny tasks with legitimate exploration plus planted drift opportunities and identical task snapshots. No production changes.
tasks.evidence: At least five independently labeled tasks with permitted scope and expected outputs

tasks.title: Create drift detector evaluation runner
tasks.delta: Evaluate T07 against fixed traces, print precision/recall and false positives; no live models required.
tasks.evidence: Machine-readable deterministic scores and false positive list

tasks.title: Create quantization benchmark recording schema
tasks.delta: Capture model family, exact weights hash, quant method, runtime, KV cache format, context, prompt, seed/temp, completion outcome; compare same base family only.
tasks.evidence: Reject comparisons missing model/quantization provenance

tasks.title: Add isolated live benchmark command
tasks.delta: Provide opt-in dry-run first; when enabled run task replay serially under static contract using available Flash/27B. No forced model allocations or automatic code promotion.
tasks.evidence: Dry-run requires no endpoint; unavailable models skipped with reason

tasks.title: Add feature flag and rollback checklist
tasks.delta: Document shadow-mode enablement, metric baselines, stop criteria, flag rollback and incident data retention; do not turn on new recovery by default.
tasks.evidence: Operator can disable each intervention and preserve evidence

tasks.title: Final cross-repo acceptance audit
tasks.delta: Gather all task SHA/handoff records, test results, source evidence, known gaps, model benchmark validity and readiness verdict. No source modifications or broad repair.
tasks.evidence: Audit explicitly distinguishes built, tested, deployed and not verified
